verdict.rationale: Sales Cloud's pricing page lists built-in Sales Flows and Lead Routing, and the product pages describe automating the sales cycle and connecting agents to Flows and Apex. A community user reports building a timed email automation in SFDC in minutes, which corroborates rule-based automation hands-on. Missing for 10: first-party documentation that explicitly describes event-triggered rules (record-change or platform-event triggers), detail on how rules and conditions are defined, and any AI-native or natural-language rule authoring.
